Step: 03-16-1487 minus 347 days.  
1487 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From Mar 16 back 347 days:  
Go to start of year: Mar 16 → 31+28+31 = 90 days into year.  
347 − 90 = 257 days before 1487-01-01.  
Move into 1486: 1486 is a common year (365 days).  
365 − 257 = 108 days into 1486.  
108 days: Jan 31 (31), Feb 28 (59), Mar 31 (90), Apr 30 (120) → 108 is Apr 17 (90 + 18 days into April).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1486-04-17
